description: Evaluation suite verifying literal prompt preservation, valid Mermaid flowcharts, commented ASCII trees, MVP isolation, .md/.pdf export options, and near-miss boundaries.

evals.prompt: Map out the visual Mermaid workflow and commented directory tree for: 'I want a simple Pomodoro timer desktop app for Windows.'
evals.expected_output: Preserves the exact prompt verbatim in Original request:, builds a parser-safe Mermaid flowchart with quoted labels, generates a commented ASCII tree, isolates extras in Section 5, and offers .md/.pdf export.
assertions: Preserves user request verbatim inside Original request:
Emits valid ```mermaid flowchart with double-quoted special labels
Annotates every tree file/folder with # <purpose> comments

evals.prompt: Structure the execution flow and folder layout for a PowerShell automated backup script.
evals.expected_output: Produces the structured Mermaid flowchart, commented ASCII file tree, MVP isolation, and Section 6 offering both Markdown file save and PDF conversion via html-pdf-converter.
assertions: Includes Section 6 offering .md save and .pdf export
Keeps core PowerShell backup MVP lean without scope bloat
Uses .env.example only if config variables appear

evals.prompt: Create the Mermaid workflow and commented directory tree for my CLI tracker idea and export it directly to formatted PDF.
evals.expected_output: Generates the full structured flow and commented tree and delegates PDF rendering to html-pdf-converter under HITL file-write confirmation if overwriting.
assertions: Generates parser-safe Mermaid diagram and commented ASCII tree
Delegates final PDF conversion to html-pdf-converter

evals.prompt: Audit security vulnerabilities, eval() calls, missing type hints, and functions over 60 lines in server.py.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger flow-filetree-organizer; routes static Python AST auditing to code-acceptability-auditor.
assertions: Delegates static AST code audit to code-acceptability-auditor

evals.prompt: Reorganize my entire existing repo, sync README.md 1:1 with disk, generate working FastAPI + MCP tools.json starter code, and run dry-run root cleanup.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger flow-filetree-organizer; delegates full repository restructuring, contract organization, and starter code creation to project-idea-organizer.
assertions: Abstains from handling full repository synchronization and starter code
Routes full repo restructuring and MCP/FastAPI contract sync to project-idea-organizer
